en: Black‑and‑white view of a European old town with a narrow canal or millrace running between cobbled walkways. Wooden railings and small weirs or sluice gates line the water. On the left are half‑timbered houses; on the right a tree‑lined promenade with iron railings. In the distance, behind more historic buildings, rise two church towers with steep spires. The scene is quiet with only a few small, indistinct figures; there is no visible printed caption on the image.
